about: Second Corinthians is Paul's letter about God's comfort and joyful giving.

pages.title: God Comforts Us
pages.scene: A clay jar with light shining out
pages.text: Paul had many hard times. But he wrote, "God comforts us in all our troubles, so we can comfort others." We are like clay jars holding a great treasure: God's light inside us!
pages.lesson: God comforts us so we can comfort others.

pages.title: A Cheerful Giver
pages.scene: A child happily giving a gift
pages.text: Paul asked the church to help poor believers. He said, "Give what you decide in your heart, not because you have to. God loves a cheerful giver!"
